head.t: Major IT migration programme causing GPs ‘real anxiety’ and severe delays, BMA warns
head.x: A national IT programme aiming to move hundreds of GP practices’ IT systems from EMIS to Vision is causing anxiety, increased admin workload and severe delays, the Scottish BMA has warned.

EMIS has rebranded as Enlivio Health, announcing an “exciting new era” following a strategy refresh, the introduction of new leadership, and a renewed focus on improving pace and consistency across product and development teams.
